scenes.headline:
Every morning, your AI agents
*forget your company.*

voice.text: Every morning... your developers open Claude Code, or Cursor. And every single morning? The agent has forgotten your company.
voice.emotion: Intriguing storyteller opening, building quiet tension, then dropping low and slow on the final words

scenes.headline: So someone explains it all *again.*
chips: Why payment retries work this way
What broke last quarter, and why
lines: The agent does good work. Then forgets all of it.
The new hire's agent knows even less than *the new hire.*

voice.text: So someone explains it all... again. The service boundaries. The naming rules. The why. And then? It forgets. All of it.
voice.emotion: Wry and exasperated, a small sigh at the start, knowing and relatable, a touch of dry humour

scenes.headline:
Put the memory in a vendor's cloud.
*Security won't sign that.*
scenes.label: BLOCKED
scenes.quote: Other than Copilot, everything is blocked. *Nothing opens there.*

stat.label: engineering leaders in one room said the same thing.

voice.text: The obvious fix? Put the memory in a vendor's cloud. But security won't sign that. Three out of eight engineering leaders, in one room, told me exactly this.
voice.emotion: Serious and matter-of-fact, firm emphasis, real weight on three out of eight

lines: One shared memory for every agent on your team.

voice.text: This is Holt Teams! One shared memory, for every agent on your team. And it never, ever leaves your servers.
voice.emotion: The big reveal: excited, bright and proud, energy lifting, a confident smile in the voice

scenes.headline: Written once. *Recalled by every teammate's agent.*

voice.text: Here's how it works. A decision gets written once... and every teammate's agent recalls it. Claude Code. Cursor. Codex. All inside your network. Nothing is sent to us. Ever.
voice.emotion: Clear, energetic explainer, brisk rhythm on the product names, firm and reassuring at the end

scenes.headline: Memory is atomic facts, *not documents.*
fields: "Payment retries use idempotency keys from the order id, never a random UUID."

callouts.title: scope
callouts.body: Only people cleared for *that path* ever get it recalled.

callouts.title: evidence
callouts.body: Seen *three separate times*, not guessed once.

callouts.title: supersedes
callouts.body: Old facts stay in history. They *never outrank* the new one.

voice.text: Memory is stored as small, single facts. Each one knows its scope, how often it's been seen... and exactly what it replaced.
voice.emotion: Thoughtful and precise, a craftsman proud of the design, gently intrigued

scenes.headline:
The store grows without limit.
*The prompt stays a fixed size.*

big.label: tokens per prompt, however big the store gets.

voice.text: Your store can grow to millions of facts. But what goes into each prompt? About six thousand tokens. Every single time.
voice.emotion: Impressed contrast: big and expansive on millions, then tight, precise and satisfied
